entities.name: Marko Popović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marko Popović is a Croatian basketball executive and former professional basketball player. Standing at a height of 1.85 m, he played at the point guard and shooting guard positions. He currently serves as a sporting director for Zenit Saint Petersburg of the VTB United League.
